verdict.rationale: The docs confirm support for GGUF LLMs across several families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi), multimodal image description with models like Qwen3.5, Ministral3 and llava1.6, and a variety of pre-built llamafiles. Speech-to-text is also available via the bundled whisperfile. However, the evidence never shows breadth anywhere near 'hundreds of architectures'. missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, independent corroboration of architecture breadth.
